info.name: SafePay Enhanced - Working API Examples
info.description: Current amount-only live policy, explicitly requested on 15 September 2026. SafePay is a simulated risk-adaptive pre-settlement transaction-control layer. Run folders 01 and 02 in order using fresh customer data and cleared operation keys: fund INR 1000000; LOW 5000 settles; VERY_HIGH 150000 needs password verification; MEDIUM 20000 is cancelled immediately within 10 seconds. Folder 05 uses HIGH 60000 for 60-second automatic settlement. Existing saved decisions and idempotency replays are never rescored. These files have not been executed against the current user server.

request.description: Use a unique email and 10-digit phone. On duplicate registration, use the existing account or change both values. Creates one SAVINGS account with INR 5000.
Postman retains JSESSIONID. Follow with a protected GET for this role to capture the new session CSRF token.
Success is HTTP 200. Obtain a CSRF token first when authenticated.

item.name: List admin accounts and capture admin CSRF

request.description: Set the absolute simulated balance to INR 1000000 for the fresh walkthrough. This is not a deposit increment. Minimum plus all held payments must remain covered.
Success is HTTP 200. Obtain a CSRF token first when authenticated.
Postman retains JSESSIONID. Follow with a protected GET for this role to capture the new session CSRF token.

item.name: LOW payment INR 5000 - first payment settles immediately

request.description: Amount-only policy: INR 5000.00 => LOW/SETTLED, 0 seconds. Beneficiary age and payment history do not change the tier. Use a new key for a new payment; retries keep the same key/body and return the saved decision.

item.name: Check balance after immediate LOW settlement

request.description: Fresh walkthrough: INR 1000000 minus one LOW payment of INR 5000 = INR 995000.

Amount-only policy: INR 150000.00 => VERY_HIGH/HARD_HOLD, 0 seconds. Beneficiary age and payment history do not change the tier. Use a new key for a new payment; retries keep the same key/body and return the saved decision. No expiry timer; balance stays INR 995000 and INR 150000 is reserved. Save transactionId for verification, not lowTransactionId.
Run once against the INR 150000 HARD_HOLD saved as transactionId; expect 403 and no debit. Five failed password attempts lock the customer for 15 minutes. Then send the correct-password request.
Wrong verification leaves the INR 150000 hold reserved without debiting the INR 995000 balance.
Verify the INR 150000 HARD_HOLD using the current customer password. Successful settlement reduces balance from INR 995000 to INR 845000.

item.name: Retry same verification - no second debit

request.description: Reuse the successful verification key and password. Existing saved settlement is returned; balance remains INR 845000.

item.name: Check balance after verified HARD_HOLD and replay

request.description: Fresh walkthrough: INR 1000000 - INR 5000 - INR 150000 = INR 845000. The verification retry must not debit twice.

item.name: MEDIUM payment INR 20000 - cancel within 10 seconds

request.description: Amount-only policy: INR 20000.00 => MEDIUM/PROTECTED, 10 seconds. Beneficiary age and payment history do not change the tier. Use a new key for a new payment; retries keep the same key/body and return the saved decision.

item.name: Cancel MEDIUM payment immediately before expiry

request.description: Send immediately after the INR 20000 MEDIUM initiation, before its 10-second database deadline. Use protectedTransactionId. Cancellation leaves the fresh-walkthrough balance at INR 845000. Run folder 02 without request delay, or prepare this tab before initiating manually.
transactionId identifies the INR 150000 verified payment. lowTransactionId identifies the separate INR 5000 immediate settlement.

item.name: Account after MEDIUM cancellation and replay

request.description: Cancellation releases the INR 20000 reservation without crediting or debiting money. Fresh-walkthrough balance stays INR 845000.
Postman retains JSESSIONID. Follow with a protected GET for this role to capture the new session CSRF token.
Only the signed-in customer's ID is allowed; another user ID returns 404.
Optional password field changes the password. If you change the email/password, also update the corresponding environment variable before logging in again.
Allowed values: ACTIVE and INACTIVE.

Amount-only policy: INR 60000.00 => HIGH/PROTECTED, 60 seconds. Beneficiary age and payment history do not change the tier. Use a new key for a new payment; retries keep the same key/body and return the saved decision.

item.name: Poll until timer expires and scheduler settles

request.description: Repeat this GET every five seconds until state is SETTLED, after the 60-second database deadline and scheduler pass. Do not cancel or verify this payment. In Collection Runner, run this polling request separately until settled before the final account check. HARD_HOLD never auto-settles.

exec: pm.test('Timed payment is PROTECTED or SETTLED', () => pm.expect(pm.response.json().state).to.be.oneOf(['PROTECTED','SETTLED']));

request.description: Run only after the preceding poll reports SETTLED. After folders 01/02 plus this INR 60000 payment, fresh-walkthrough balance is INR 785000. Other payments or admin balance edits change this expectation.
